verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an official hosted MCP server at use.jitsu.com/mcp that lets agents create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events and edit Functions. It authenticates via OAuth 2.1 for interactive clients or a personal API key for headless use. Jitsu also exposes a Management HTTP API covering workspaces, sites (sources), destinations, connections, syncs and functions, with a claimed OpenAPI 3.0 reference. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the checked paths, though the documented location was not tested).
